newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Feilong to list 20.8 mln A shares in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Feilong to list 20.8 mln A shares in Shanghai.

text.p: Hengyang Feilong Co Ltd, based in the central Hunan province, said on Wednesday it expects to list 20.80 million A shares on the Shanghai bourse by the end of this month.
A company spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin that Feilong's listing had been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
China Economic Development Trust and Investment Co has been appointed to be Feilong's listing promoter, he said.

The official said the 20.80 million A shares were issued at one yuan per share about eight years ago. He said Feilong currently has a total share capital of 50.80 million shares, including 30 million shares issued to institutions.
Feilong forecast net earnings of 0.28 yuan per share for this year, up from 0.18 yuan per share in 1995 and 0.13 yuan in 1994, he said.
Feilong, which specialises in building materials, also operates a cement plant with an annual capacity of 200,000 tonnes.
